name: Fenadiazole
summary: Fenadiazole (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name; also known as phénadiazole (DCFTooltip Dénomination Commune Française); brand names Hypnazol, Eudormil, and Viodor) is a hypnotic and sedative medication which has been used to treat insomnia but is no longer marketed.

uses.text: Fenadiazole (INN; also known as phénadiazole (DCF); brand names Hypnazol, Eudormil, and Viodor) is a hypnotic and sedative medication which has been used to treat insomnia but is no longer marketed. The drug was synthesized, pharmacologically characterized, patented, and marketed by the French pharmaceutical company Laboratoires Jacques Logeais between 1960 and 1962.

summaryZh: 酚二唑（英語：Fenadiazole，全稱2-(1,3,4-噁二唑-2-基)苯酚，商品名有Hypnazol、Eudormil、Viodor等），分子式C8H6N2O2，是一種安眠藥，帶有一個1,3,4-噁二唑官能團，最初由法國洛斯大藥廠合成。
